name: Syncthing
tagline: Continuous, peer-to-peer file synchronization between your devices.
description: Syncthing synchronizes files directly between your devices, without a central server, keeping folders in sync while your data stays private.
postInstall: Open it and set a user name and password for its interface in Actions, Settings, GUI.
Add your other devices with their device IDs, then share folders under /var/syncthing.
